verdict.rationale: HumanLayer can create structured tasks from GitHub, Linear, and Jira issues, so feedback that already lives in a tracker can become a task. It also offers PRD-Oriented and RPI workflows that add review before implementation, which suggests a path to proposed scope. However, nothing shows intake of user-feedback submissions or automatic scope proposals; tasks are framed as coding-agent work units. Missing for 10: direct ingestion of user feedback submissions, documented generation of proposed scope from feedback, a PM-facing triage flow, hands-on or independent corroboration.
